Gogoi, Advocate  Mr. P. K. Deka, Advocate  BEFORE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEVASHIS BARUAH  ORDER 07.08.2024 None appears on behalf of the petitioner on call. 
2. Mr. B. Gogoi, the learned counsel appears on behalf of the respondent No.2 and Mr. P. K. Deka,
the learned counsel appears on behalf of the respondent No.5. 
3. This Court upon perusal of the orders dated 17.07.2023 and 28.07.2023 is of the opinion that the petitioner must have lost interest in the matter in view of the observation made therein, and as such,
the petitioner has not appeared. 
4. Accordingly, the instant writ petition stands dismissed for non- prosecution.
